description: Memchor's Claude Code hooks. Each runs the memchor command on PATH; without it, session start says how to install it and the others do nothing.

hooks.command: command -v memchor >/dev/null 2>&1 || { printf '%s\n' '{"systemMessage":"◪ memchor · not running: the memchor command is not on PATH (npm install -g memchor)"}'; exit 0; }; exec memchor hook session-start --host claude-code
command -v memchor >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; exec memchor hook subagent-start --host claude-code
command -v memchor >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; exec memchor hook user-prompt-submit --host claude-code
command -v memchor >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; exec memchor hook pre-tool-use --host claude-code
command -v memchor >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; exec memchor hook stop --host claude-code
